Name: Global Warming - Mountain River with water
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]Well this summer was very hot in Stardew Valley and the eternal ice on the peaks of mount Stardew are melting like its 2020! So the river in the mountains is full of water. How nice :)!

Honestly, i didnt like the sad look of the dry riverbed. Stardew Valley is a happy and beautiful place. This didnt really fit for me. So here we go!



INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but recommended, to switch easy on/off in case you want to change.
2. download the  Mountain_River.rar
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the "[CP] Mountain River With Water" folder into your Mods folder.
5. Configuration.json gets created after first start with the mod. You can
edit the settings via Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it installed.
6. feedback is welcome, enjoy :)!

UPDATE:
just copy and replace everything.  But you should delete the old config file, since i changed the names of the values ( otherwise you will get a warning on startup and SMAPI will do it for you, so no problem)


DEINSTALLATION:
1. delete the "[CP] Mountain River With Water" folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Works with everything that does not edit/replace the Mountain.tbin Map.

KNOW ISSUES:
1. So far none.

Thanks for your download, enjoy and let me know if you have any suggestions or find bugs!
